name: Trakt
description: Each member links their own Trakt account to report what they watch and sync watched history. Also adds the Trakt community rating to movies and series.

descriptionI18n.zh-TW: 每位成員連結自己的 Trakt 帳號，回報正在觀看的內容並同步已看紀錄。另外為電影和劇集加上 Trakt 社群評分。
descriptionI18n.zh-CN: 每位成员连接自己的 Trakt 账号，汇报正在观看的内容并同步已看记录。另外为电影和剧集加上 Trakt 社群评分。
